sources.entry: GithubStarsManager - AI-powered, local-first app to organize your GitHub stars with auto-summaries, tags, semantic search, and release tracking.

summary.one_liner: GithubStarsManager is a local-first web and desktop app that syncs your GitHub stars, uses AI to summarize and tag them, and offers semantic search, release tracking, and an MCP server for agents.
summary.what_it_does: Syncs the repositories you have starred on GitHub into a local library. AI generates summaries, tags and categories in bulk, with pause/resume and locked categories that AI will not overwrite. Vector search over repo descriptions or READMEs (via a Cloudflare Vectorize worker) supports natural-language queries and a "find similar repositories" action, with keyword fallback. Release tracking lets you subscribe to repos, filter assets by platform and file type, and download in the browser or via aria2. It also includes fork and GitHub Actions management, Gist management, a per-repo Q&A assistant pinned to a commit, and a read-only MCP server so agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can query your enriched stars. Optional Express and SQLite backend adds cross-device sync and proxied API calls.
use_cases: Organize hundreds of starred GitHub repos
Find a starred repo by describing what it does
Track new releases of projects and download installers
Let an AI coding agent query my starred repos
Back up and sync star metadata across devices
Discover trending GitHub projects by language or platform
how_to_run: Clone the repository or download the source
Run `npm install` in the project folder
Run `npm run dev` to start the app locally
Or run `docker-compose up -d` for the frontend and backend (ports 8080 and 3000)
Or use the packaged desktop client from the README link
notable: AI-managed library: bulk summaries, tags and categories with locked categories that AI will not overwrite
Read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP and SSE) with bearer-token auth, enabled from Settings
Per-repo Q&A assistant pinned to a specific commit with traceable evidence
Interface available in 10 languages and 12 theme presets
caveats: Runs fully in the browser without a backend, but data then lives in localStorage and needs manual backups
Browser-only dev mode (npm run dev) can hit CORS failures for AI and WebDAV calls; the backend or desktop client avoids this
Vector search needs a Cloudflare Worker deployment and an embedding provider; changing models requires a full index rebuild
Q&A assistant is marked early-access and does not index whole repositories; the local plugin system and MCP server are desktop or backend only
The author states the app was written by AI and bug fixes are not guaranteed
